author: reek
body: Proves the per-turn public-zone sweep. An agent keeps running state of the opponent's open zones -- graveyard, exile, and the battlefield -- by folding them into its Knowledge at the end of every turn. Here the opponent has a card in the graveyard, one in exile, and a creature on the battlefield, and the agent had earlier seen that creature in hand via a reveal. After the sweep the agent knows exactly where each card is, and the creature it saw in hand has correctly moved to the battlefield -- it is no longer counted as held.
